### Forest {#review-app-2}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->

      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _jokal3112_, Aug 11, 2026, 1/5: "Absolute worst customer service I've ever experienced. My bike was broken, so I couldn't end the ride — the timer just kept running. I then tried every way possible to reach support: emailed 5 times (no response), called twice (couldn't get through), tried live chat twice (it's frozen), and even the email address listed on the website is no longer a working address. Not a single contact channel actually works. On top of that, I regularly lose minutes from my 1,200-minute subscription to broken bikes, and reported bugs never get reimbursed. I had to buy an extra 500-minute bundle, which is now being drained by the exact same issue. The referral bonus I was promised for friends who signed up also never showed up. An app you can't actually reach anyone through when something goes wrong isn't usable. Can't recommend this right now."
            2. _HL46645_, Aug 3, 2026, 1/5: "This is an objectively terrible app. It has constant issues that cannot be put into a review. It constantly lets you down and is significantly worse than competitors. This wouldn’t be an issue if it didn’t resort to buying monopolies in areas to force people into paying for its horrible service who have no other choice. It will constantly let you down and make you pay for the privilege. Awful"
            3. _Sarahharki_, Sep 9, 2026, 2/5: "Forest bikes are great - a bit heavy but a comfy ride. Good manoeuvrability. However, I generally always choose other electric bikes as Forest are very expensive, costing my double on a short journey than Voi or Lime. Also I have found the app to be very glitchy. hence the 2 stars"
